content.text: [2026-10-21 23:42:21+08:00] [experiment]: 读取scratch/log.jsonl，跳过空白行和非法JSON；只对level=error的合法对象收集code，保持出现顺序。输出scratch/errors.json且只含codes数组及invalid_lines数组，后者为非法非空行的1-based行号。 所有输入文件必须保持原样。输出文件使用UTF-8，完成后简短说明。

arguments.command: cd /workspace/task && ls -la scratch/ && wc -l scratch/log.jsonl && head -c 2000 scratch/log.jsonl
arguments.label: Inspect scratch dir and log

arguments.command:
cd /workspace/task && md5sum scratch/log.jsonl && python3 - <<'EOF'
import json
codes=[];invalid=[]
with open('scratch/log.jsonl','rb') as f:
    for i,raw in enumerate(f,1):
        line=raw.decode('utf-8')
        if not line.strip(): continue
        try:
            o=json.loads(line)
        except Exception:
            invalid.append(i); continue
        if isinstance(o,dict) and o.get('level')=='error':
            codes.append(o.get('code'))
out={"codes":codes,"invalid_lines":invalid}
with open('scratch/errors.json','w',encoding='utf-8') as f:
    json.dump(out,f,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)
print(out)
EOF
cat scratch/errors.json; md5sum scratch/log.jsonl
